response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong credentials, but his career shows minimal recent hands-on C++ work (last significant C++ use was at National Instruments in 2014-2015, and briefly for a bachelor thesis), no Windows-platform C++ development, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure aside from a brief unrelated fintech-adjacent stint at RIDE Capital using Node/TypeScript/GraphQL. This is a fundamental mismatch against the mandatory skills required for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience
Demonstrated strong communication skills via talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
Proven ability to work across many languages and paradigms, showing adaptability
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ Windows development experience (last C++ role ended in 2015)
No SQL Server or Oracle experience mentioned; only generic SQL/MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent Windows C++ experience
No fixed income/capital markets domain expertise
